nl: Revert the commit 'Switch timeout to 14 seconds' with a new revert commit (default message). Later commits stay.

setup.description: A Git repository; the commit to revert is the second newest.
setup.bash:
git init -q -b main
git config user.name 'Bench User'
git config user.email bench@example.com
git config core.autocrlf false
printf '%s' '# worker-4
' > 'README.md'
mkdir -p 'src' && printf '%s' 'print('\''v1'\'')
' > 'src/app.py'
git add -A && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2026-10-01 08:00:00 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2026-10-01 08:00:00 +0000' git commit -qm 'Initial commit'
mkdir -p 'src' && printf '%s' 'def helper():
    return 1
' > 'src/util.py'
git add -A && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2026-10-01 08:01:00 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2026-10-01 08:01:00 +0000' git commit -qm 'Add helper module'
printf '%s' 'timeout = 30
' > 'config.ini'
git add -A && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2026-10-01 08:02:00 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2026-10-01 08:02:00 +0000' git commit -qm 'Add configuration file'
printf '%s' 'timeout = 14
' > 'config.ini'
git add -A && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2026-10-01 08:03:00 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2026-10-01 08:03:00 +0000' git commit -qm 'Switch timeout to 14 seconds'
mkdir -p 'src' && printf '%s' 'def helper():
    return 3
' > 'src/util.py'
git add -A && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2026-10-01 08:04:00 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2026-10-01 08:04:00 +0000' git commit -qm 'Return 3 from helper'
setup.pwsh:
git init -q -b main
git config user.name 'Bench User'
git config user.email bench@example.com
git config core.autocrlf false
[IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PWD 'README.md'), '# worker-4
')
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force 'src' | Out-Null; [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PWD 'src/app.py'), 'print(''v1'')
')
git add -A; $env:GIT_AUTHOR_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:00:00 +0000'; $env:GIT_COMMITTER_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:00:00 +0000'; git commit -qm 'Initial commit'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force 'src' | Out-Null; [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PWD 'src/util.py'), 'def helper():
    return 1
')
git add -A; $env:GIT_AUTHOR_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:01:00 +0000'; $env:GIT_COMMITTER_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:01:00 +0000'; git commit -qm 'Add helper module'
[IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PWD 'config.ini'), 'timeout = 30
')
git add -A; $env:GIT_AUTHOR_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:02:00 +0000'; $env:GIT_COMMITTER_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:02:00 +0000'; git commit -qm 'Add configuration file'
[IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PWD 'config.ini'), 'timeout = 14
')
git add -A; $env:GIT_AUTHOR_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:03:00 +0000'; $env:GIT_COMMITTER_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:03:00 +0000'; git commit -qm 'Switch timeout to 14 seconds'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force 'src' | Out-Null; [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PWD 'src/util.py'), 'def helper():
    return 3
')
git add -A; $env:GIT_AUTHOR_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:04:00 +0000'; $env:GIT_COMMITTER_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:04:00 +0000'; git commit -qm 'Return 3 from helper'

subjects.stdout:
Revert "Switch timeout to 14 seconds"
Return 3 from helper
Switch timeout to 14 seconds
Add configuration file
Add helper module
Initial commit

oracle_program: git.log "." message: "Switch timeout to 14 seconds" count: 1 |> git.revert
reference_pwsh: $h = git log --format=%H --grep='Switch timeout to 14 seconds' -F -n 1; git revert --no-edit $h
